title: Player-Bank-System
description: A comprehensive bank system for Paper/Spigot, featuring Vault integration, player account storage, and deposits and withdrawals via commands.
body:
### **Bank System**

BankSystem is a player-focused banking plugin for Paper and Spigot servers that integrates seamlessly with Vault. It allows players to securely deposit and withdraw money

## using simple **commands:**

/bank deposit <amount|all> – Deposit a specific amount or all your on-hand money into your personal bank account.

/bank withdraw <amount|all> – Withdraw a specific amount or all your banked money.

/bank info – Check your current bank balance.

Each player has their own individual configuration file, so balances are tracked and saved automatically. Permissions are fully supported via LuckPerms, giving server administrators full control over who can access banking commands. All transactions are synced with the server’s economy, making it ideal for roleplay, economy-based servers, or any server looking to add a secure player banking system.
